title: zenodo-openalex-collection: keep an OpenAlex collection of a Zenodo community up to date
description: A reusable GitHub workflow and R pipeline (targets) that keeps an OpenAlex collection of the deposits in a Zenodo community up to date. It downloads all versions of all deposits from Zenodo, checks the community for changes per configurable interval (with an optional finer recheck), re-downloads only changed intervals, and builds the OpenAlex collection from the concept DOIs with openalexPro, searching all OpenAlex corpora. Each community repository holds only a config file, a short workflow and two secrets; runs, data (kept in GitHub releases) and collections belong to that repository and its accounts.
